lines.text: forth buds of every kind; We bring forth the green blade from which We bring forth
the thick-clustered grain; and from the date-palm, from the pollen thereof, spring
pendant bunches; and (We bring forth) gardens of grapes, and the olive and the
pomegranate, alike and unlike. Look upon the fruit, thereof, when they bear fruit,
and upon its ripening. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe.
The Originator of the heavens and the earth.
And in the Earth are neighboring tracts, vineyards and ploughecl lands, and
date-palms, like and unlike, which are watered with one water. And We have
made some of them to excel others in fruit. Lo! herein verily are portents for
Such is Allah, your Lord. There is no God save Him, the Creator of all things, so
worship Him. And He taketh care of all things.
